Package com.egradx.auth.account

Class EgradxEmailCodeService

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.account.EgradxEmailCodeService
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
public class EgradxEmailCodeService extends Object implements org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
Six-digit codes emailed for signing in without a password, and for signing up (docs/auth/sign-in-methods.md).

Asking for a sign-in code answers the same whether or not the address has an account; a code is sent only to an active one. Checking a code answers EMAIL_CODE_INVALID alike for a wrong code, an unknown address and no code at all. Wrong codes count, and the count is kept though an exception is thrown — hence noRollbackFor.

Sign-up makes, when its code is entered, the account, a new organization it administers, and a session there.

    • sendSignInCode

      @Transactional public void sendSignInCode(String email)
      Emails a sign-in code to the account at email, if there is an active one, replacing any earlier code. Says nothing either way: an unknown address, a request inside the resend interval and a message that could not be sent all return normally.
      Throws:
      ValidationException - EMAIL_CODE_UNAVAILABLE when codes are not offered here at all
      EgradxTooManyAttemptsException - when this address has asked for too many codes

    • verifySignInCode

      @Transactional(noRollbackFor=ValidationException.class) public EgradxAuthResult verifySignInCode(String email, String code, UUID organizationId)
      Signs in with the code emailed to email. The code works once. When the person belongs to several organizations and chose none, ORG_SELECTION_REQUIRED is thrown and the code is kept, to be sent again with organizationId.
      Throws:
      ValidationException - EMAIL_CODE_INVALID, EMAIL_CODE_EXPIRED, EMAIL_CODE_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS, ORG_SELECTION_REQUIRED

    • startSignup

      @Transactional public EgradxSignupStartedDto startSignup(EgradxStartSignupRequest request)
      Starts a sign-up: checks it is allowed and emails a code to request.email(), replacing any earlier one.
      Throws:
      AuthorizationException - SIGNUP_DISABLED
      ValidationException - SIGNUP_EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED, PASSWORD_INVALID, EMAIL_CODE_RATE_LIMITED, EMAIL_CODE_UNAVAILABLE
      DuplicateResourceException - EMAIL_IN_USE, ORGANIZATION_NAME_IN_USE

    • confirmSignup

      @Transactional(noRollbackFor=ValidationException.class) public EgradxAuthResult confirmSignup(String email, String code)
      Completes a sign-up with its code: the account, a new organization it administers, and a session there.
      Throws:
      AuthorizationException - SIGNUP_DISABLED
      ValidationException - EMAIL_CODE_INVALID, EMAIL_CODE_EXPIRED, EMAIL_CODE_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS
      DuplicateResourceException - EMAIL_IN_USE, ORGANIZATION_NAME_IN_USE — taken meanwhile

    • requireSignupAllowed

      public void requireSignupAllowed(String email, String organizationName)
      Refuses a sign-up that may not go ahead: the domain is not allowed, the address has an account, or the organization name is taken. Shared with signing up through a provider.
      Throws:
      ValidationException - SIGNUP_EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED, or a missing organization name
      DuplicateResourceException - EMAIL_IN_USE, ORGANIZATION_NAME_IN_USE

      Makes the account and the organization it administers, checking again that both are free. The account's username is its email; passwordHash may be null.
